Hi Michael,

My name is Jon Clark, and I’m interested in your 2016 Nissan Altima with 83,223 miles. That said, I have some concerns about the asking price.

$12,600 is above the top of the KBB private-party range ($10,990–$12,540) and significantly higher than the estimated private-party value of $11,765 for this model and mileage. Before I can get close to that number, I need full transparency on the mechanical history.

Has the car had any recent transmission service, suspension work, or deferred maintenance? Any accidents, paintwork, or title issues I should know about? At 83k miles, there are likely some upcoming service items, and I price those into my offer.

With the market value and potential unknowns in mind, my opening offer is **$10,800**, contingent on a clean pre-purchase inspection. I’m a serious buyer and can move quickly for the right car at the right price, but I need to know exactly what I’m buying first.

Let me know the service history and your thoughts.

Best,  
Jon Clark

I'm still a serious buyer and can close quickly, but I will not pay healthy-car prices for a vehicle with a hidden transmission problem. If you're willing to deal transparently at $8,000, let me know and we can finalize. Otherwise, I'm walking.

Jon Clark
